digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and persistent tickets clone
propositions: The persistent tickets clone on EBS volume is not refreshed by redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, preserving divergent history across deployments.

The entrypoint invokes reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block, so convergence must run when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset, but the script currently does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset divergent state.
The autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS at line 90 omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh, preventing deliver of scripts-only changes to the ensure script itself.

Convergence must use union-safe reconverge for compatible stores and narrow adoption only for pre-epoch local tips that are ancestors of readable prior remote tips, preserving local-only commits and requiring operator intervention for divergent states.
A failed or credentialless fetch must exit best-effort success, preserve the exact local tip, and emit operator-readable warnings so set -eu cannot abort an already-cast Gerrit vote.
The artifact writer catches store errors inside artifact_emit.py after the vote is cast, so convergence failure must remain best-effort and never undo or wedge a recorded vote.
